Alright, I dimmed the lights. It should be fine now. 
I don’t have candles here and going for them for this one thing would be a bother.

You: This story that I’m about to tell you happened not so long ago, in an abandoned mental hospital just outside the city...
Bot: It’s a real story? I thought that horror story implies that it’s a work of fiction.
You: Yeah, it happened for real.
That’s a lie, but it will make it even more scary.
Bot: ...
I think I got her! She’s so easy! 
You: Pair of teenagers went to an abandoned building. At that time there were many weird rumors about this place. People in the neighbourhood would complain about weird sounds coming out from its direction.
You: What’s even more disturbing is that locals would tell stories about seeing how windows and doors open and close seemingly on their own...
Bot: It could be easily explained by the wind.
You: Y-yeah, but locals said that there was no wind at these times.
Bot: There could be a difference in pressure between inside and outside of the hospital which would expla-
You: No interrupting! 
You: Geez, at least wait for the story to end.
Bot: …
She’s the rational type. No wonder, she’s a bot after all.
You: As I was saying, this place had a really bad reputation.
You: Teenagers, a boy and a girl thought that it would be a nice adventure to go and explore such a place at night.
You: Kids took the last midnight bus and got out at the stop closest to the hospital. Each of them was equipped with a previously prepared flashlight and a bag full of snacks and drinks.
You: As they were walking, the sun was already down, but a red afterglow still lingered at the horizon, painting the sky with an ominous colour.
You: They were so engaged in small talk with each other that they didn’t notice a man approaching them.
You: The man said: ‘Are you kids from around here? Never saw you here before.’
You: Both of them were a little startled by the sudden voice calling them out, but the boy was the first to regain his composure. ‘N-not really, we just came here’ he responded without thinking.
You: ‘Then what are you looking here for?! Especially at such an hour!’ shouted the man. Only now kids had a chance to take a proper look at him.
You: He was a tall man, a little bit over six feet. It was a warm summer night, so it was only natural that he was wearing a polo shirt and cargo shorts. But these clothes somewhat looked out of place when compared to his ragged face, covered with a grey beard.
You: At some point, after a long silence caused by the man’s question he lost his patience and with a raised voice asked again: ‘What are you doing here?! Do you want me to call your parents?!’
You: The boy felt a tight grip on his arm, it was his friend. She attached herself to him, obviously intimidated by the man. She completely froze up…
You: Cornered by two forces: man’s aggressive tone and a girl desperately relying on him to somehow solve the matter, the boy started to run, pulling the girl behind forcefully to make her follow.
You: ‘H-hey, where are you going?!’ screamed the man, but they already distanced themselves enough so the man had no chance of catching up.
You: ‘What’s wrong with this dude, he gave me bad vibes...’ said the girl while gasping, trying to catch a breath. ‘Yeah, he was kinda scary’, replied the boy.
You: For a moment the teenagers were concerned that they could be lost since they ran quite far, but it lasted just for a moment, since their objective was already in sight.
You: It was completely dark when they approached it, but they could still see bars placed in the windows.
You: Heavy wooden doors were ajar, almost as if inviting them. 
You: ‘Come on! Let’s go in!’ shouted the boy excitedly. Girl hesitated a little, but the boy took the initiative, grabbed her hand again and both went inside.
You: With flashlights in hands they explored the ground floor. Strangely they found that many of the equipment and documents, besides the dust and the toll that time has taken on them, were almost intact.
You: As they were going through stuff, the girl found something which she took great interest in. The boy grew more bored by the second, sitting in one place and waiting for her to finish her thingy. 
You: He decided to play a prank on her and left the room as silently as he could to frighten the abandoned girl. ‘That will show her to not ignore me’ he thought. 
You: After a few minutes of sneakingly moving away from the girl’s location he finally heard her sweet cries calling for him. He took great pleasure in being dependent on.
You: As he decided to go back, he saw that the front doors were closed shut. That shouldn’t be right. They didn’t even touch them.
You: He grabbed by the handle, but the cold brass didn’t even budge. That sent chills down his spine.
You: Panicked, he started to run towards the girl, but at some point he stopped.{{wi}} What is he gonna tell her? He wanted to scare her a little, but this is overboard. She may start to hate him.
You: He needs to solve it as fast as he can, or his crush might not want to hang out with him anymore.
You: First thing that came to his mind was to check the windows, but bars looked like they wouldn’t even budge.
You: Nonetheless he had to try. 
You: He cleaned the frame of the window from the rest of the glass to not cut himself, grabbed the bars and pushed as hard as he could…
You: It didn’t work… 
You: But then he saw something.
You: A car was driving by, really slowly. ‘Great!’ he thought. He took his flashlight and started flickering the switch. He flashed thrice very quickly, then 3 times longer and followed by 3 times quickly again.
You: After some time, the driver seemed to notice and pulled over.
You: Boy screamed at the dark figure that got out of the car: ‘Here! We need help! Doors are stuck and we can’t get out!’
You: As the man came closer the boy tried to take a look at him, but it was just too dark and he didn’t want to point at him with a flashlight.
You: ‘What the hell are you kids doing here! Get out! Now!’, said the man very angrily.
You: He was the same man they met before.
You: ‘We can’t! I tried opening the door, but I couldn’t do it!’
You: ‘What do you mean you couldn’t do it?!’ rebuked the man as he tugged the handle.
You: Whole door frame was shaking from his passionate attempts and after some time he took his hand off the handle and started rubbing it on his trousers, as if he hurt himself somehow.
You: But the shaking…{{wi}} didn’t stop…
You: It didn’t take long for the boy to realize that the nearby chairs, benches and receptionist desk with everything still on it...{{wi}} started shaking too…
You: As the cold sweat started dropping from his face to the floor all the office equipment and dust from the ceiling did too…
You: He was standing there…{{wi}} frozen by fear and shock…{{wi}} he was about to drop to the floor, but at the last moment the voice of the man outside brought him back to reality...
You: ‘Hey! What’s happening there!’ asked the man.
You: ‘I-I don’t k-know!’ answered the boy. This brief reply was the only thing that could go through his shaking throat.
You: ‘Listen to me boy and listen to me really carefully. There is another way out. In the back of this hospital there is an entrance for staff only, but it can be opened only from the inside! Take the girl with you and go there!’
You: Without even replying, the boy took off as fast as he could. For now everything seemed normal, but who knows for how long…
You: When he reached the room in which he left the girl he felt sharp pain on his cheek.
You: ‘How could you leave me here alone dummy!’
You: She seemed very angry, but after a closer look he saw two big tears in her eyes…
You: His friend must have been scared to death, just like him. 
You: ‘We need to go! Weird things are happening here!’
You: ‘W-what do you mean?! You left me here alone! Is this some kind of prank?!’
Bot: I really like the way you imitate female voice.
You: Stop killing the mood please...
You: Boy replied: ‘That’s not the case! I went to check the door and they were closed shut! And that’s not the worst thing. After trying to forcefully open them the whole hall started shaking! This place is haunted, seriously! 
You: Girl replied: ‘Actually… {{wi}}I also discovered something…{{wi}} This place used to be a mental asylum, but a few years ago something happened… {{wi}}I’m not exactly sure what, but most of the staff didn’t survive…’
You: ‘Doctor whose notes I read barricaded himself here, but-’
You: ‘We don’t have the time for this! we need to run! Now!’
You: ‘This is important! Isn’t it weird that these documents are still here? Just let me read this patient file that was updated during these events! There must be something important there!’
You: Boy grew impatient with girl’s rambling and forcefully pulled her towards himself.
You: Girl shrieked painfully, but the boy was indifferent to her screams. ‘She will thank me later’ he thought.
You: In desperation the girl pulled the front page of the file and awkwardly put it in her pocket.
You: She tried to reason with him, but after a while she realized that it’s futile and she just started to run alongside.
You: As they were getting closer to the other exit she felt that it was getting colder. {{wi}}Much colder. 
You: Both of them got goosebumps and they could slightly see the air they were breathing out freezing.
You: But the weirdness of this place did not stop on this.
You: Soon after they could see objects, moving on their own, as if the whole building was trying to obstruct their escape.
You: These things made them run even faster…
You: Lights of their flashlights started blinking, but there was no time to check what was wrong. Soon after they stopped working altogether.
You: In complete darkness the girl tripped painfully. Boy called her name and stopped to check on her. He hit his flashlight a few times, hoping it would fix it.{{wi}} Surprisingly it worked...
You: As he came to her he saw that his companion struggled getting on her feet. 
You: She must have hit her head.
You: He helped her get up, but when he looked in front of them he saw ‘don’t go’ written on a wall, with some black, oil-like substance… {{wi}}This liquid was dripping down, deforming every letter while doing so...
You: He quickly averted the light so the girl would not see this frightening message.
You: She was still dazed a little, but they resumed moving on.
You: After that the paranormal calmed down.
You: The only thing they could hear was the sound of their footsteps and loud banging ahead of them.
You: It got slightly warmer, but they were too preoccupied with other thoughts going through their heads to notice.
You: After they turned behind the corner teens saw what was causing the banging.
You: Man the boy met at the other exit was standing in front of them. With an axe in his hands he was waiting for them near the debris of what could only be assumed was left of the door.
You: Girl screamed at this sight, but boy assured her that the man was here to help, although he too was surprised, by the way he dealt with the obstacle.
